notes: Partition verified: 13 source and 18 target ids each used once across 14 units (13 source units plus one added).

*how* is correctly added under rule 55: the clause writes no complementizer, and the negative, the finite verb and the bare infinitive each already have their rendering; folding it into דַּבֵּר would be the fold rule 55 forbids. The competing reading (*how to speak* as one rendering of the infinitive) is named in the unit note.
s012/s013 follow rule 20 exactly — the supplied *am* joins the predicate noun and אָנֹכִי takes only *I*.
The suffix of אֲדֹנָי is unrendered (*Lord*, not *my Lord*), so unrepresented under rule 22 is right.
